question.worked_solution:
The integral is defined over a type II region.

First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2y}(3{x}^{2}y+{e}^{x})\,dx\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{2y}(3{x}^{2}y+{e}^{x})\,dx]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{x}^{3}y+{e}^{x}]_{0}^{2y}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(((2y)^{3}y+{e}^{2y})-((0)^{3}y+{e}^{0}))\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(8{y}^{4}+{e}^{2y}-1)\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}(8{y}^{4}+{e}^{2y}-1)\,dy & ={[\frac{8}{5}{y}^{5}+\frac{1}{2}{e}^{2y}-y]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(\frac{8}{5}+\frac{1}{2}{e}^{2}-1)-(0+\frac{1}{2}{e}^{0}-0) \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2}}{2}+\frac{1}{10}\end{aligned}
$$
